newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Metcash expects yr shr up at least 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Metcash expects yr shr up at least 24 pct.

text.p: South African wholesale store chain Metro Cash & Carry Ltd said on Tuesday it expected earnings growth for the full year to be not less than that achieved in the first half.
The company earlier reported headline earnings up 24 percent to 38.8 per share in the six months to October 31.

"Notwithstanding the current bearish economic outlook, with both the Christmas and Easter trading periods to come in the second half, earnings growth for the full financial year is expected to be not less than that achieved in the first half," the company said in a statement.

The company's international expansion programme into various countries, mainly in Africa and the Middle East, was continuing at a steady pace and it expected to open new stores in Zimbabwe, Kenya and Zambia in the next six months.
Another store would open in Uganda at a later stage, it added.
